samples:
If you could, how long would you choose to live?
forever / less_than_normal / a_normal_lifespan / several_centuries / a_few_extra_decades

Which do you think about more: the past, the present, or the future?
the_past / the_future / all_equally / the_present

What is the ideal age to be?
old_age / thirties / twenties / childhood / middle_age / teenage_years

Which regret is worse: something you did, or something you never tried?
equally_bad / something_i_did / something_i_never_tried

What is the best thing about getting older?
wisdom / nothing / confidence / deeper_relationships / caring_less_what_others_think

What is the hardest thing about getting older?
losing_time / losing_looks / losing_health / losing_people / feeling_irrelevant

If you could stop aging at one point, what would you choose?
middle_age / prime_of_career / young_adulthood / wouldnt_stop_aging

How do you usually feel about the passage of time?
just_right / i_dont_notice_it / it_goes_too_fast / it_goes_too_slow

What kind of legacy matters most?
impact_on_others / things_i_created / no_legacy_matters / children_and_family / work_and_achievements

If you could relive one decade of your life, which would it be?
none / teens / twenties / childhood / most_recent_decade

What would you do differently if you had a year left to live?
travel / quit_my_job / nothing_much / finish_a_project / spend_time_with_family

Is nostalgia a good or bad feeling?
bad / good / depends / bittersweet

child.label: Aging & Lifespan
child.description: Questions about growing older, how time feels as it passes, stages of life, how long the answerer would want to live, and regrets looking back.
child.not_for: Death itself, dying, funerals, last words, and how you want to be remembered (use Death & Legacy).
examples: Would you take a pill that stopped aging?
Does time seem to pass faster as you get older?

samples:
How often do you think about your own death?
Never / Only at funerals or near misses / A few times a year / Every week / Every day

Should people plan their own funerals?
yes_in_detail / leave_simple_wishes / no_leave_it_to_family

How should death be viewed?
a_mystery / a_natural_end / a_tragedy_to_fight / the_thing_that_gives_life_meaning

If a test could reveal the year you will die, what would you do?
take_the_test / refuse_the_test / take_it_only_if_the_result_could_be_changed

What would you most want to be remembered for?
my_work / my_family / my_kindness / my_adventures / my_creativity / not_remembered

How would you prefer to die, if you could choose?
suddenly_in_my_sleep / surrounded_by_family / doing_something_i_love / with_time_to_say_goodbye

What should happen to your body after you die?
burial / cremation / no_preference / natural_burial / donated_to_science

Would you want your social media accounts kept up after your death?
deleted / dont_care / handed_to_family / kept_as_a_memorial

What is the best way to honor someone who has died?
a_private_memory / a_celebration_of_life / a_traditional_funeral / telling_their_stories / carrying_on_their_work

What is the most important thing to do before you die?
see_the_world / leave_something_behind / make_peace_with_the_past / say_what_matters_to_people

How much does fear of death affect your daily life?
Not at all / Only in scary moments / It sometimes stops me from taking risks / It weighs on me most days

How important is it to be remembered after you die?
Not important at all / Nice but not necessary / Fairly important / Very important

child.label: Death & Legacy
child.description: Questions about death and dying, talking about death, funerals and memorials, last words, belongings left behind, and how you want to be remembered.
child.not_for: Aging, lifespan, stages of life, and how time passes (use Aging & Lifespan).
examples: Should people plan their own funerals?
Are you comfortable talking about death?
